# International Journal of Health Sciences and Research (IJHSR)

> An NMC-approved, open-access peer-reviewed journal publishing health sciences research with global indexing across major academic databases.

IJHSR is a peer-reviewed academic journal focused on health sciences and medical research. The journal maintains NMC approval status and is indexed across multiple international databases including Embase, CrossRef, and Google Scholar, making research widely accessible to the global academic community.

## Key Topics

- open-access journal
- peer-review process
- manuscript submission
- health sciences research
- medical research
- journal indexing
- NMC approved
- academic publishing

- maternal-child health
- contraceptive devices

- [NMC Approved Journal; Archive: IJHSR](https://ijhsr.org/archive_ijhsr.html): Archive of past volumes and issues of IJHSR journal
